checkedAlternates.risk: Blackberries and raspberries are called berries in English.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Botanically, Rubus berries are aggregate clusters of tiny drupelets (group-2), whereas kiwifruit is a true simple berry (group-1).
Cherries contain a single hard endocarp pit enclosing one seed, making them drupes (group-3), not multi-seeded berries (group-1).
